ℹ️ Hardware vs Daemon: Simultaneous multi-button combos are powered by the Linux background daemon. Hardware BLE profiles map 1-to-1 button keys directly in the controller's physical EEPROM memory.

Simultaneous Multi-Button Combos

Press 2 or more buttons together (e.g. L1 + R1, Select + Start) to trigger instant chords or shell commands.

Direct BLE GATT Hardware Flashing ('80EL')

Flash a profile directly into the 8BitDo Micro's physical hardware memory. The controller will remember this mapping on any computer, iPad, or Android phone without running software.
